$comment: Cap Breakers in the NBA 2K series let a player raise a small number of attributes above the cap
the builder allowed, earned after launch. The count, the per-attribute limit, the eligibility
rules and whether they cost build points are ALL unknown for 2K27 and invented here.
The optimizer treats cap breakers as a POST-BUILD overlay: it optimizes the build first, then
recommends where each +1 lands by measuring which single point crosses the most valuable

eligibility.note: mode may be 'all', 'all-except' (uses excludedAttributes) or 'only' (uses includedAttributes).
